title: ARMS Revising
skills: apply the ARMS strategy: add, remove, move, and substitute
revise ideas and organization before surface-level editing
improve clarity, coherence, and development in a draft
make purposeful changes during the revision stage of writing
alignment_note: Introduces the ARMS revision strategy—Add, Remove, Move, and Substitute—as a practical framework for improving a draft. Although commonly taught in earlier grades, it provides accessible review, intervention, and multilingual reinforcement for substantive revision, organization, clarity, and recursive writing across high school English courses.
